It was supposed to go down like all of the others, except this time, they walk away from the scene with a body on their hands. But once fear and desperation seep in, it's not long before she finds herself confiding in her on-again-off-again boyfriend, Duke — breaking her pact and setting off a chain of events that leaves every woman for herself. programme.title: Unintended Consequences
